jobs.title: Director, Clinical Research- Benign Hematology
jobs.description: Overview  Alnylam Pharmaceuticals is seeking an imaginative physician drug developer, with the flexibility and confidence to work across diseases within the neurology and hematology therapeutic area.  This role includes the opportunity to provide clinical leadership in developing RNAi therapeutics in Alnylam’s expanding portfolio, which spans from rare genetic to common diseases. The successful candidate’s primary role will be one of the clinical study leads working on the plasminogen program transitioning from Phase 2 to Phase 3. The Director will report directly into the program clinical development strategy lead who provides the clinical research oversight of the program. The Director is expected to play a leading and influencing role in the overall clinical development strategies and drive progress and operational excellence of his/her clinical trial(s). This work will also involve extensive consultation and collaboration with external experts. The Director, Clinical Research, will work in a matrix organization across Regulatory, Biostatistics, Clinical Operations, Preclinical, Commercial & Quality Assurance teams to ensure fully harmonized and integrated development strategies. The Director will be a key Alnylam Development spokesperson at external meetings, including regulatory interactions and scientific meetings.   Key Responsibilities   Be a subject matter expert for the relevant disease area(s) Be the strategic leader providing a strong, clear voice for the clinical program Develop creative but realistic approaches to drug development and lead clinical efforts towards global regulatory approvals Oversight of trial conduct and safety Collaborate closely with Preclinical, Regulatory Affairs and Medical Affairs to ensure tight strategic integration of product development plans. jobs.title: Lead Product Manager - Patient Data Collection (x/f/m)
jobs.description: Set a new pulse for healthcare! We are looking for a Lead Product Manager to join the Patient Profile team in the Patient domain. Your mission will be to make the patient health record complete, accurate and current enough that everything else we build can act on it, the health recommendations, care plans and assistant experiences that help people take their health into their own hands. You will work in a feature team developing the Patient Health Record, health trackers, patient account and online identity, contributing directly to the quality of the medical support we provide to both patients and practitioners. A patient record is built from four channels: what patients enter themselves, what they share when preparing a consultation, what we retrieve from health professionals' systems, and what they connect from third-party sources such as Apple Health, Google Health Connect and national health record services. Three of those channels belong to teams you will not manage. You will own the outcome across all four, the most leveraged place to sit in a health platform, and only reachable through other people. You will also work inside a hard regulatory perimeter: health data, GDPR, consent by design.
